messages:
Aria V: quick question  booked lounge access at LHR while delayed, used personal card bc corp card declined. Charge shows 'PRIORITYPASS*LHR' £ 32.50 on 2026-05-11. Is this reimbursable?
Marta (Finance): hi Aria, yes airport lounge access can be reimbursed if delay > 2 hours or for overnight layovers per policy. Please submit an expense with the screenshot of the transaction and the lounge receipt if you have it. If you don't have an itemized receipt, complete the missing receipt form and get manager sign-off.
Aria V: I have the email receipt from Priority Pass (attached: pp_receipt.pdf) but the boarding pass that shows the delay is on my phone, I'll upload a photo.
Raj P (Manager): approved 44d I confirm the flight was significantly delayed and Aria was on company travel. Approving reimbursement.
finance-bot: Expense created EXP-5992. Status: pending attachments (boarding pass photo). Reimbursement scheduled for next cycle after verification.
Marta (Finance): once attachments are in place set category = TRVL-LOUNGE and project = TRIP-LON-MAY26. If company card ever declines during travel, please open a corpcard issue ticket so we can avoid personal charges.
